effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` WETH to the vault (ERC4626 _deposit uses safeTransferFrom from the caller), and the vault supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
The vault mints shares to `receiver`. The number is assets*(totalSupply+10^offset)/(lastTotalAssets+1), rounded down, so it depends on storage.
The vault accrues interest first and mints performance-fee shares to the fee recipient. This does not change the WETH amount the signer pays.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit" with the WETH amount, a raw 'Share ticker' row reading ymvOG-WETH, and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the receiver gets; the vault sets that from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. No field shows the share amount. Case 0: 9777410903 ymvOG-WETH minted to 0x...dEaD.
findings.fix: None possible: the share amount comes from vault storage.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' names neither the asset nor the vault, and there is no interpolated intent.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`, no interpolatedIntent. The ticker sits in a separate raw row: `"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"`. Case 0: the reader was unsure which contract receives the WETH.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit WETH into Yearn vault". Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for ymvOG-WETH shares to {receiver}".

cases.notes: Signer pays 1e-8 WETH and the screen shows 0.00000001 WETH. The shares go to 0xdEaD (signer null), and the screen shows that recipient.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns shares from `owner`. The number is assets*(supply+10^offset)/(lastTotalAssets+1), rounded up, so it depends on storage.
The vault pulls the WETH from Morpho markets and sends exactly `assets` WETH to `receiver`.
When `owner` is not the signer, the call spends the signer's share allowance from `owner` (ERC4626._withdraw calls _spendAllowance).
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw" with the exact WETH amount, the receiver ('To') and the share owner ('Owner').

findings.title: withdraw does not show the vault shares burned from the owner; the vault computes that number from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. Case 1: the signer lost 33798681422235202 ymvOG-WETH, and no field shows a share amount.

findings.title: withdraw never names the vault or the ymvOG-WETH shares it burns; the intent is only 'Withdraw'.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: `"intent": "Withdraw"`, and the fields are assets, receiver and owner only. Case 1 reader: "Which Yearn vault this is, since the screen shows no vault name or address". The deposit format does show the vaultTicker constant.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw WETH from Yearn vault". Add a field with value `$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker` labeled 'Shares burned from'. Add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}".

cases.notes: WETH in, 0.035, is shown right. The ymvOG-WETH shares burned (0.0338) are not shown. The reader knew some vault shares leave but not how many or from which vault.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` ymvOG-WETH from `owner`, spending the signer's allowance when `owner` is not the signer.
The vault sends WETH to `receiver`. The amount is shares*(lastTotalAssets+1)/(supply+10^offset), rounded down, and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem" with the share amount in ymvOG-WETH, the receiver and the owner. The WETH received is not named at all.

findings.title: redeem never names WETH as the asset the receiver gets; the reader had to guess the payout token.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format: the fields are shares (tokenPath @.to), receiver and owner, with no field for the underlying token. Case 2: the signer received 9069082607057775 WETH. Reader: "Which token is paid out (name suggests WETH, screen doesn't say)".
findings.fix: Add a field with value `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker` labeled 'Receive'. Change the intent to "Redeem shares for WETH".

findings.title: redeem does not show the WETH amount received; the vault prices it from storage with no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The function takes no minimum-assets parameter. Case 2: the signer received 0.009069 WETH, and no amount is shown.
findings.fix: None possible: the amount comes from storage.

cases.notes: The 0.008852537511575117 ymvOG-WETH shares out are shown right. For the WETH in, the screen shows neither the asset nor the amount; the reader guessed the underlying.
